verdict.rationale: CrewAI's source is published in a public GitHub repository (crewAIInc/crewAI), and first-party docs describe the core as 'the open-source framework' that CrewAI AMP extends. Readable source plus an explicit open-source claim covers the core of the story. Missing for 10: the specific license is never named in the evidence, and there is no independent confirmation of license terms or of which parts (the framework versus AMP and Crew Studio) are open.
